headline.title: The AI Era Is Creating a Bug Hunting Arms Race
headline.summary: The rise of AI-driven exploit development is intensifying the competition in the search for software vulnerabilities, prompting a shift in bug hunting strategies. Security experts are adapting to the evolving landscape as attackers increasingly leverage AI technologies to enhance their capabilities.

articles.title: NeuroNL2LTL: A Neurosymbolic Framework for Natural Language Translation of Linear Temporal Logic
articles.summary: NeuroNL2LTL is a neurosymbolic framework designed to translate natural language into Linear Temporal Logic (LTL), addressing the challenges of expertise and correctness in formal verification for safety-critical development. The architecture combines learned translation methods with formal verification to enhance expressiveness while maintaining reliability.

articles.title: ImProver 2: Iteratively Self-Improving LMs for Neurosymbolic Proof Optimization
articles.summary: ImProver 2 is a neurosymbolic framework designed to enhance the optimization of formal mathematical proofs by addressing challenges such as heterogeneous objectives and high training costs. The framework aims to improve the maintainability of verified proofs and the quality of training data for neural provers.

articles.title: Mediative Fuzzy Logic: From Type-1 Foundations to Type-2, Type-3 and Quantum Extensions
articles.summary: The article presents a comprehensive framework for Mediative Fuzzy Logic, extending its foundational principles from type-1 to include type-2, type-3, and quantum variations. It aims to address the underdeveloped logical and semantic aspects of this approach, particularly in the context of fuzzy control and decision-making.

articles.title: KPI2KVI: A Multi Agent Workflow for Calculating Key Value Indicators from Service Descriptions
articles.summary: The article presents KPI2KVI, a multi-agent workflow designed to facilitate the calculation of Key Value Indicators (KVIs) from service descriptions. It addresses the challenges of selecting KVI categories, defining measurable Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and applying consistent calculation logic to derive actionable insights for stakeholders.

articles.title: RAG4Outcome: A Retrieval-Augmented Multimodal Framework for Prognostic Prediction in Chronic Osteomyelitis
articles.summary: The article introduces RAG4Outcome, a retrieval-augmented multimodal framework designed to improve prognostic predictions for chronic osteomyelitis by addressing the limitations of traditional manual scoring systems. This framework aims to enhance scalability, efficiency, and consistency in clinical assessments by effectively managing the heterogeneous nature of clinical data.

articles.title: DRL-Driven Edge-Aware Utility Optimization for Multi-Slice 6G Networks
articles.summary: The article discusses a framework for optimizing resource allocation and edge caching in 6G networks, specifically targeting Virtual Reality services that require low latency and high bandwidth. It utilizes Deep Q-Network (DQN) learning to enhance dynamic resource provisioning across multiple network slices in an O-RAN-compliant architecture.

articles.title: Do Synthetic Brain MRIs Reliably Improve Tumour Classification? A StyleGAN2-ADA Class-Plane Augmentation Study on BRISC 2025
articles.summary: A study published on arXiv investigates the effectiveness of synthetic brain MRIs generated by StyleGAN2-ADA in improving tumor classification accuracy on the BRISC 2025 dataset. The research focuses on whether the addition of GAN-generated samples enhances performance in medical imaging tasks, highlighting the potential benefits of generative augmentation in small datasets.

articles.title: 6G Communication Networks Enabling Embodied Agents: Architecture and Prototype
articles.summary: The article explores the communication requirements of embodied agents and how 6G technology can address these needs through its features like sub-millisecond latency and ultra-high reliability. It highlights the lack of systematic studies on leveraging 6G capabilities for enhancing communication in embodied agents.

articles.title: Online Hand Gesture Recognition Using 3D Convolutional Neural Networks
articles.summary: The article presents a new online hand gesture recognition system that utilizes 3D Convolutional Neural Networks to detect and classify dynamic hand gestures in real-time video streams. The proposed system addresses challenges such as response lag and variability in gesture performance among different users.

articles.title: Any2Any: Efficient Cross-Embodiment Transfer for Humanoid Whole-Body Tracking
articles.summary: The Any2Any framework introduces an efficient method for transferring pretrained whole-body tracking models across different humanoid embodiments, minimizing the need for extensive adaptation. This approach aims to reduce the costs associated with training models from scratch, facilitating quicker deployment on various humanoid platforms.

articles.title: PhotoFlow: Agentic 3D Virtual Photography Missions
articles.summary: The article discusses PhotoFlow, a new approach to virtual photography that enables an agent to navigate a 3D scene and generate images based on scene information and language intent without preselected camera poses. This development highlights advancements in vision-language models while addressing the challenges of evaluating complex 3D spatial reasoning and camera parameter selection.
